references.text: Continuation of the same law regarding giving a heave offering (terumah) from the first of the dough to the Lord when they eat of the bread of the land.
Command to bring the first of the land's firstfruits to the house of the Lord, establishing the principle of giving from the land's produce to God.
Repeats the command to bring the firstfruits of the land's produce to the house of the Lord.
Law concerning bringing the first sheaf (omer) as a wave offering to the Lord when they enter the land and harvest its crops.
Command to take from the firstfruits of all the fruit of the ground when they enter the land, and bring it as a heave offering to the Lord.
Describes when the Israelites began to eat of the land's produce after entering Canaan, which is the context in which this command applied.
Ezekiel repeats the principle that the first of all firstfruits and all offerings belong to the priests, to bring blessing upon the house.
